name: Kanazawa University Virtual Campus
summary:
A 3D virtual recreation of the Kanazawa University campus. Put on your headset and explore the campus as if you were walking there in person.

■ For everyone (trial mode, no account needed)
- Pick an avatar and walk freely around the campus on your own.
- Visit the main buildings, including Ishikawa Gate, the Administration Building, the Central Library, the faculty buildings, the Student Hall and the large lecture halls.
